changes.title: Profile Icon Header Button & Profile-Page Logout Relocation
changes.description: Replaced the verbose header user-info bar with a compact profile icon button matching the Login button footprint. Hovering the icon reveals a frosted-glass dropdown with student ID and email. Moved the Logout button from the header to the Profile page, right-aligned alongside the Back to Hub button.

changes.title: Mobile CMS Submissions Dropdown Filters & Collapsible Card Accordions
changes.description: Refined mobile CMS workspace to maintain 95% container width with optimized padding. Integrated Feedback filter directly into the mobile filter dropdown for complete single-selector filtering. Converted submission cards on mobile into interactive accordion dropdowns displaying only title and badges by default, smoothly expanding details on demand.

changes.title: Canonical URLs & Automated Netlify-to-GitHub Pages Redirection
changes.description: Added canonical link tags pointing to official GitHub Pages origin (https://ou1ts.github.io/portal/) and implemented automatic client-side redirection for incoming traffic from ou1ts-portal.netlify.app and ouits-res.netlify.app with path, query, and hash preservation.

changes.title: Wide CMS Workspace, Mobile Tab Icons & Mobile Submissions Dropdown
changes.description: Streamlined Portal Admin CMS into a dedicated wide layout (1440px / 95% width) directly in the profile switcher, replacing the redundant popup modal. Optimized mobile experience by hiding tab button text labels to show clean icons with counts, and converted submissions filter pills into an accessible mobile dropdown.

changes.title: CMS Submissions Styling, Role Selector & Admin Delegation Safeguards
changes.description: Enhanced Google Sheet submissions with lighter, high-contrast submitter social links. Applied dark-glass styling to role filters and profile edit buttons. Added sole administrator protection preventing lockout by making revoke read-only. Streamlined Add User modal to register regular members only with list-based admin toggling.

changes.title: Add & Provision Users in CMS Admin Delegation
changes.description: Admins can now directly add, pre-provision, or update users in the Admin Delegation section with custom role assignment, search by student name/email/ID, and role-based filtering.

changes.title: Google Sheets Submissions Tracking Table & Admin View Switcher
changes.description: Connected live Google Sheets form responses to database table public.portal_sheet_submissions with deterministic row IDs. Automatically detects added vs pending submissions with 1-click approvals. Added seamless Profile View <-> CMS View toggle switcher for admin users.

changes.title: Expanded Featured Projects Pool & Mobile Semi-Transparent Gallery Arrows
changes.description: Expanded rotating featured projects pool to select the top 3 submissions from all 11 catalog lists (~30 projects total) with dynamic random shuffle. Added left and right navigation arrows to mobile viewports with a sleek semi-transparent frosted glass design.

changes.title: Portal CMS, Central Resources Database & Admin Delegation
changes.description: Implemented full Content Management System (CMS) modal for approving community resources, auto-arranging entries into Supabase categories, managing Google Form feedback submissions, delegating portal-scoped admin roles with a user selector modal, and dynamic star-based featured projects ranking.

changes.title: Service Worker Fetch & Origin Interception Fix
changes.description: Implemented same-origin and GET filtering in service-worker.js, added self.skipWaiting() and clients.claim(), and eliminated undefined cache responses that caused net::ERR_FAILED errors across local assets.

changes.title: Central Database Integration & Star Ranking System
changes.description: Connected login and profile systems to the centralized oU1TS Supabase database, added automatic 'portal' project tagging, and implemented the stars ranking architecture across all JSON catalog resources with database-backed RLS policies and live sorting.

changes.title: 100vh Floating Nav Canvas Showcase & Seamless Scroll Reappearance
changes.description: Scrolling to the Explore Hub Resources section smoothly expands the navigation canvas to 100vh with all resource nodes showcased together in full view while adjacent sections glide out of view. Immediately on any scroll action, the canvas smoothly contracts and adjacent sections fluidly reappear.

changes.title: Optimized Section Spacing & Mobile Bubble Padding
changes.description: Reduced top margins for the top auth bar on desktop and featured projects section on mobile, and refined padding around icons and text labels inside mobile floating navigation bubbles.

changes.title: Scroll Persistence for Floating Navigation Canvas
changes.description: Prevented mobile scroll gestures from re-arranging category bubbles by ignoring height-only viewport resize events from browser address bars and caching randomized slot allocations for the session.

changes.title: Eliminated Featured Gallery Layout Shifting (CLS)
changes.description: Implemented CSS Grid slide stacking with consistent description line reservation, preventing page height fluctuations and jumps when navigating between projects.

changes.title: Border-Snapped Bottom-Right Rank Badge
changes.description: Repositioned the top-ranked project indicator to sit snapped flush in the bottom-right corner of the featured section container.

changes.title: Compact Numerical Gallery Counter
changes.description: Replaced the horizontal long bar dot indicators with a clean numerical counter (e.g. 01 / 05) with tabular numeral alignment.

changes.title: Optimized Section Spacing Across Hub Layout
changes.description: Reduced vertical gaps between the Featured Projects gallery, Floating Navigation canvas, and About & Socials section by eliminating extraneous break tags and tightening responsive margins and padding.

changes.title: Desktop Bubble Typography & Icon Retention on Mobile
changes.description: Preserved full desktop typography (0.72rem) and icon scale (1.6rem) for mobile category bubbles while reducing internal padding, paired with a clean icon-only circular top changelog button on mobile.

changes.title: Global Footer Links Placement Below All SPA Subviews
changes.description: Relocated the Source Code and Documentation footer link pills below GROUP_SPA_SECTIONS so they consistently appear at the very bottom of every category page and the home hub.

changes.title: Minimal Mobile Bubble Padding & Enhanced Link Separation
changes.description: Reduced excessive internal padding on mobile category bubbles down to 1px with scaled typography and icon sizes, while expanding the visual safety gap and physical separation distance between circular links.

changes.title: Centered Community Social Links Row
changes.description: Centered the community social links row directly beneath the About section title on all devices for balanced horizontal symmetry.

changes.title: Clean Mobile Header Changelog Button
changes.description: Streamlined the header Changelog button on mobile viewports by hiding the version badge pill, displaying only the clear icon and label.

changes.title: Unified About & Socials Section with Clean Background
changes.description: Merged the About and Socials sections into a seamless borderless layout with direct social icon links placed beneath the heading, concise description copy, and modern glass pill links for Source Code and Documentation.

changes.title: Header Changelog Pill & Sidebar Streamlining
changes.description: Moved the Changelog trigger button directly into the top header navigation bar next to login and commented out the legacy sidebar for an uncluttered single-page browsing experience.

changes.title: Multi-Category Top 3 Featured Project Randomizer
changes.description: Expanded the Featured Projects showcase to dynamically draw from across all 10 project datasets, selecting at random from the top 3 of each category for an unpredictable, multi-project gallery cycling on every visit.

changes.title: Vertical Tags Arrangement Under Project Thumbnail
changes.description: Relocated ranking and category badges directly underneath project thumbnails in a neat vertical stack, keeping both desktop and mobile views aligned without overlapping descriptions.

changes.title: Top-Left Brand Subtitle & Left-to-Right Typewriter Animation
changes.description: Relocated portal subtitles directly below the top-left site brand logo with a dynamic left-to-right typewriter effect and smooth tag reveal, completely clearing the redundant hero section.

changes.title: Featured Projects Compact Mobile Layout & Integrated Badges
changes.description: Optimized the featured project carousel for mobile screens with a significantly reduced height, left-aligned thumbnail with visit button underneath, right-aligned project details, and bottom-right corner ranking tags.

changes.title: Compact Mobile Floating Bubbles & Single-Screen Discovery
changes.description: Reduced diameter and padding for resource bubbles on mobile screens, fitting all 11 category links comfortably within a single viewport without tall canvas scrolling.

changes.title: Silky Smooth 7-Second Single Inactivity Auto-Scroll
changes.description: Upgraded idle inactivity detection to trigger after exactly 7 seconds of inactivity for the first time only, smoothly gliding downward to the Explore Hub Resources with cubic physics easing.

changes.title: Automated Visitor Changelog Modal & Service Worker Version Detection
changes.description: Implemented automated 'What's New' changelog modal that triggers whenever a new Service Worker cache version is deployed, featuring desktop and mobile trigger buttons, version history accordion, and offline fallback.

changes.title: Centered Intro Preloader with Corner Docking Animation
changes.description: Engineered an introductory loading screen that displays centered on load and seamlessly glides into the top-left logo position using dynamic bounding rect calculations.

changes.title: Dynamic Featured Projects Changing Gallery Carousel
changes.description: Built an interactive showcase carousel randomly presenting top-ranked projects from curated collections with auto-rotation, arrow navigation, and pagination indicators.

changes.title: Playful Floating Resource Bubbles Navigation
changes.description: Introduced an organic floating bubble canvas for exploring materials, tools, guidance, community links, and capstones with dynamic physics-inspired micro-animations.

changes.title: Supabase Authentication Centralization & Secure RLS
changes.description: Secured Supabase client access, centralized configuration in env-config.js, and implemented Row Level Security policies for user stars and capstone submissions.
